         ('VAV_F3_Z01.Damper_Position_Setpoint','damper')]
ids={k:v for k,v in cmap.items() if any(v==t[0] for t in target)}
print({cmap[k][0:40]:'y' for k in ids})
rows=list(csv.reader(open(VALUES_CSV)))[1:]

for rid,ts,val in rows:
    if rid in ids: d[rid].append((ts,float(val)))
for rid,l in d.items():
    l.sort()
    name = [t[1] for t in target if cmap[rid]==t[0]][0]
    print(name, len(l), l[0], '...', l[-1])
    mm=defaultdict(list)
    for ts,v in l: mm[ts[:7]].append(v)
    line=[]
    for m in sorted(mm):
        if m<'2017-05' or m>'2019-01': continue
        line.append((m,round(sum(mm[m])/len(mm[m]),2)))
    print('   ', line)
